about: The data strapi-php's export of transfer/component-media-export.tar.gz holds: run on an empty strapi-php project (with the fixture's types), seeded with a full-access token, then `php bin/strapi export --no-encrypt -f component-media-export`. Files linked from the items of a repeatable component (Storyboard.frames, each frame's image): two storyboards share a file, one frame has none, and a book's own cover links the same file as a frame.

writes.name: a storyboard whose frames link files
a book whose cover is a frame's file too
